meta.title: Grit & Perseverance Test
meta.description: A 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of grit — passion and perseverance for long-term goals.

levels.label: Unstoppable Grit
levels.desc: You persevere through obstacles, boredom, criticism, and setbacks with remarkable consistency, staying committed to long-term goals year after year.

levels.label: Strong Grit
levels.desc: You show gritty persistence in most situations, with a few areas — like recovering from public failure or pushing through plateaus — still developing.

levels.label: Developing Grit
levels.desc: You persevere well in many situations, though motivation, boredom, or comparison to others can sometimes derail your follow-through.

levels.label: Emerging Grit
levels.desc: You show real effort and commitment at times, but setbacks, tedium, or competing distractions often interrupt your long-term follow-through.

levels.label: Inconsistent Grit
levels.desc: Sustained effort is often difficult to maintain, and setbacks or boredom tend to end your pursuits early. Small, repeatable habits could help.

levels.label: Grit Foundations Needed
levels.desc: Long-term persistence is a significant current challenge. Building tolerance for small setbacks and short daily habits is a strong starting point.
